arguments.summary: Triage status: no unanswered PROPOSED questions remain. Questions 1–3 were already answered and question 4 was approved, is material, and has been assigned to Company task-9. The draft remains insufficient-evidence pending that targeted filing-note review and the pre-existing valuation/relative-market gaps.

claims.text: The latest listed NVIDIA periodic filing is the FY2027 Q2 10-Q filed August 26, 2026, which is the identified primary document for the approved targeted review of receivables, inventory and long-term-debt notes.

Question 4 is material and potentially resolvable because readable filing notes could determine whether balance-sheet changes evidence a discrete credit, supply-commitment, or financing risk, rather than remaining an uninterpretable growth/investment effect.

gaps.description: The approved Company review of readable Q2 FY2027 filing notes (question-4/task-9) is pending; balance-sheet changes remain uninterpretable until it reports.
No current NVDA valuation, price, market expectations, or relative performance versus SPY/XLK is evidenced.
Available completed work found no quantified issuer linkage from customer financing conditions or interest rates to NVDA revenue, margin, backlog, or collections.

assumptions: No balance-sheet risk conclusion or numerical macro/valuation adjustment will be made before the approved filing-note review supplies primary evidence.
arguments.counter_thesis: Strong reported growth and guidance could continue to dominate near-term discussion, but that does not resolve valuation-based relative-return asymmetry or establish that monetary conditions have a measured NVDA-specific fundamental effect.

review_conditions.description: Incorporate task-9’s filing-note evidence if it resolves question-4; retain balance-sheet changes as a disclosure gap if it does not. Obtain current valuation and SPY/XLK-relative evidence before any directional 21/63-session assessment.
